note: The cars a player can pick in the lobby (P1-C03, R101/R110). Data, any number of rows, no cap. Playtest 1 ships the Cruz Missile only (R81's canonical model); a row without `art` is drawn as a silhouette in the player's colour (`shape`). Stats are 0-10 bars; the real ones are measured by the sim, not typed (master 7.6). The pick goes to the host in `Pick{vehicle: id, open}` (jj-protocol); the TV names it from this file, and shows an unknown id tidied up.
